ordered_diagnoses: Hallopeau-Siemens subtype of Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa
Epidermolysis Bullosa with Congenital Localized Absence of Skin

s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic ulcerative skin condition with persistent lesions and areas of healthy skin
salient_findings: Patch of healthy skin on the left forearm
key_facts: Patch of healthy skin measures 7.5 × 4 cm²
Blood cell genotyping revealed compound heterozygous alterations in COL7A1
RNA transcript analysis showed dominant RNA transcripts with premature stop codons in affected skin epidermis
Potentially revertant area epidermis had high rates of wild-type transcripts
Revertant skin dermis had rare wild-type reads
Immunofluorescence and transmission electron microscopy showed type VII collagen and anchoring fibrils

raw.rationale: The patient's compound heterozygous alterations in COL7A1 and the presence of a large unhealed ulcer with a patch of healthy skin are consistent with Recessive Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa. The RNA transcript analysis showing dominant RNA transcripts with premature stop codons in affected skin epidermis and high rates of wild-type transcripts in the potentially revertant area epidermis also supports this diagnosis.
